name: task-router
description: Configurable model pools with strict validation, migration, compatibility checks and routing explanations

interface.shortDescription: Route tasks through configurable model pools
interface.longDescription: Uses a dispatcher skill and deterministic role-based model selection. Supports persistent user configuration, v1 migration, compatibility diagnostics and per-candidate explanations. Delegation and bounded retry are performed by the host agent; this plugin does not intercept API requests or recover a failed host model.
